title: An AI-derived oocyte score is associated with IVF outcomes in a retrospective cohort
summary: The study analyzed 14,420 oocytes from 1,856 ICSI cycles using repeated patient-level validation, propensity weighting and mixed-effects analyses. The retrospective associations do not show that using the score improves live-birth outcomes or establish prospective clinical benefit.
ai_technology: The MAGENTA AI-derived score was evaluated for associations between oocyte features and fertilization and blastocyst outcomes.
